items.title: 68004_Howard McGhee oral history interview
items.q: Like, Miles and all the guys used to come by my pad.

ctx.x: Well, I was snorting it at first. Then finally, I got the point, "Well, I got to go that way because it takes longer to get high from snorting it than from shooting." So we just switched over.

Like, Miles and all the guys used to come by my pad. I used to live on 45th Street, and in fact, everybody and his brother came by and said, "Hey, Maggie, can I use your bathroom?" I said, "Well, yeah..."
